audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-4 read Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Skill / Skill while the why-text under them said level 1 favours you, level 3 favours you, levels 4-5 stay yours and level 6 is yours.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Warwick, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Ornn, Ornn] at 54.04% for Warwick, and the whys were written against exactly that. Ornn is a scaling tank whose damage arrives with items, so the early rows belong to the champion with max-health damage and sustain.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4 to Warwick and row 1 to Skill on both layers as matched pairs; ratings adjusted; rows 5-6 left with Ornn.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly ordered: your level 3-5 window, level 6, his first tank item flip, and full build. Only the wording needed real numbers.
audit.corrected: Added Volcanic Rupture 9-7s and Call of the Forge God 140s at rank 1 so the timings are concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Warwick was credited with a 'Q reset' and the level-6 spike ignored Ornn's denial tools.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast is a 365-range lunge, not an auto reset. The decisive interaction is the other way round: Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar and a slow, and both his Q and E create terrain, which is exactly what stops a lunge or a leap. Searing Charge only knocks up when he collides with terrain, so his own pillar is the setup.
audit.corrected: Removed the false reset and built the sequencing around biting after the pillar lands rather than into it.

edits.before: W attack speed turns on against low-HP targets. Only take the trade when Ornn's Volcanic Rupture is down.
edits.after: Blood Hunt only turns on below 50% health, so level 2 is even — respect the 9s Volcanic Rupture pillar.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ornn must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online — Volcanic Rupture's pillar and slow deny your lunge, so bite him after it lands, never into it, and out-sustain the poke.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s and Call of the Forge God is 140s at rank 1 — force the level-6 fight before tank items and Brittle arrive.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you: Q reset and Blood Hunt speed out-trade his slow poke.
edits.after: Level 3 favours you: Jaws' max-health bite out-trades his 800-range poke.

edits.before: Your Q heal and Blood Hunt speed win every trade before Ornn is tanky — punish him hard while his Brittle combo damage is still low and he can't peel.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast heals for damage dealt and Ornn is not tanky yet — punish while Bellows Breath Brittle is his only real damage and his pillar sits on 9-7s.

edits.before: Infinite Duress locks Ornn down and bursts him before he can Call of the Forge God knock you back; use it while his damage is still weak.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s, but Volcanic Rupture's slow and pillar can deny the leap — bite first, then ult, while his 140s R is down.

edits.before: Levels 3 to 6 are yours: your Q reset and W speed beat him before he stacks armor, and Infinite Duress at 6 bursts him through his frontline; punish every skirmish while you still out-damage him.
edits.after: Levels 3 to 6 are yours: Jaws' max-health bite beats him before he stacks armour, and at 6 Infinite Duress suppresses him for 1.5s; punish every skirmish while you still out-damage him.

notes: Packet flagged 'Searing Charge' in wants.foe[1] as a probable wrong name — it is a FALSE POSITIVE; Searing Charge is Ornn's real E and the pillar-knockup description is accurate, so it was left alone. Mirror said it realigned rows 1,2,3,4,6; I aligned rows 0-4 to the packet chart and left rows 5-6 as Ornn, which the whys already support. Whether Ornn's E knockup breaks an Infinite Duress already in progress is not in the kit text and stays unstated. Brief games=1480 but packet games=557.
